mechanism: Both drugs have negative inotropic effects and can cause hypotension; propranolol inhibits metabolism of chlorpromazine via CYP2D6, increasing chlorpromazine levels; chlorpromazine may increase propranolol levels through protein binding displacement.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; consider dose reduction of chlorpromazine; monitor for increased antipsychotic and beta-blocker effects; ECG monitoring may be warranted.
